mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base (user_id, name, description, chunk_size, overlap) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{chunkSize}, #{overlap})
mapper.select:
SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.chunk_size, kb.overlap, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `document` d WHERE d.kb_id = kb.id AND d.deleted = 0) AS doc_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_chunk dc WHERE dc.kb_id = kb.id) AS chunk_count,
CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(kb.created_at) * 1000 AS UNSIGNED) AS created_at FROM knowledge_base kb WHERE kb.user_id = #{userId} AND kb.deleted = 0 ORDER BY kb.created_at DESC

SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.chunk_size, kb.overlap, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `document` d WHERE d.kb_id = kb.id AND d.deleted = 0) AS doc_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_chunk dc WHERE dc.kb_id = kb.id) AS chunk_count, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(kb.created_at) * 1000 AS UNSIGNED) AS created_at FROM knowledge_base kb WHERE kb.id = #{id} AND kb.user_id = #{userId} AND kb.deleted = 0
SELECT id, chunk_size, overlap FROM knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, chunk_size = #{chunkSize}, overlap = #{overlap}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE knowledge_base SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
